engine.name: Market Core V2.0-Alpha
engine.status: business behavior preserved; global application version is 39.2.11

notes: 39.2.11 is the workspace-freedom freeze candidate built on the validated 39.2.10 ghost-dock and 39.2.9 hover-chrome behavior.
The operator can compose the cockpit around the current task: show, reduce, hide, detach or restore operational surfaces without suspending their business runtime.

Math Core remains a single instrument with Classic docked behavior and native Dessus/Latéral/Réduire controls; its Administrator chrome is now explicitly anchored to the far-right lower edge to prevent the orphan-left close control seen in 39.2.8/39.2.10 testing.
Global bottom dock ghost behavior is preserved: very faint at rest, readable on dock hover/focus, full contrast on direct control hover.
Local operational controls remain faint at rest and reveal on parent hover with unchanged hit targets.
Window layout storage intentionally remains erith_admin_portal_39_2_9 because this build is a visual/control-anchor polish and must not reset the operator layout.
No market, chart, Atlas, NØX, Aerith, Memory, Bridge, Ollama, WebSocket, timer or business-state behavior is changed by this build.
